amanda_sales: Quick sync — ZenCloud POC kickoff this week. They want SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and RBAC mapping. Can we confirm what we can support in a 2-week POC?
ben_ae: Congrats! Short answers: SAML SSO + SCIM delta sync supported. RBAC mapping we can do via group->role mapping (manual CSV or SCIM groupClaims).
amanda_sales: They asked about domain proofing — can they use TXT or do we require CNAME? They also want to know if they can self-host keys (KMS) for Private deployments.
raj_engineering: For hosted we accept TXT or CNAME for domain verification; we prefer CNAME for automatic renews, TXT is fine for one-off proofs. Private supports customer KMS (HSM/KMS) — requires config in onboarding.
liz_seclead: Security questionnaire: they asked about assertion-level encryption, SOAP artifacts, and SAML signing algos. We support RSA-SHA256 signing and allow signed assertions. We don't support encrypted assertions in Hosted mode right now (we can in Private).
amanda_sales: Good — Jira question: will encrypted assertions block the POC? ZenCloud said they need encrypted assertions by default.
ben_ae: If encrypted assertions are a hard requirement, Hosted POC won't work. Offer Private eval or a short lab where we enable encrypted assertions on a dedicated test env — that adds ~2-3 business days to setup.
raj_engineering: SCIM details: we support SCIM 2.0 endpoints. Default sync cadence is delta via /Users and /Groups. Example curl to create a group: ```curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/scim/v2/Groups" -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"displayName":"eng-team","members":[{"value":"u-123"}]}'```
ben_ae: RBAC mapping options: 1) SCIM group -> Redwood role mapping 2) SAML group claim -> role via mapping table 3) Manual CSV upload for initial sync. Recommend option 1 for lowest maintenance.
amanda_sales: Pricing ask: ZenCloud wants Dedicated capacity pricing vs hosted. Also asked if SCIM calls count against token-based usage.
l liz_seclead: (typo) sorry ignore last
ben_ae: Pricing: Dedicated is monthly reserved pricing — provide estimate based on qps and concurrency. SCIM/API calls are billed under management API calls (not per-token generation) — small monthly fee tiers for provisioning volume. I'll pull the numbers.
amanda_sales: Can we get a checklist I can send to their IdOps? They want required SAML metadata fields and a list of DNS steps.
raj_engineering: I'll paste a minimal checklist: 1) Provide IdP SAML metadata (entityID, SingleSignOnService URL, x509 cert) 2) Provide group claim name (e.g., groups or memberOf) 3) Provide SCIM base URL + token 4) Decide domain proof method (CNAME preferred) 5) If using Private, provide KMS ARN / HSM details 6) Desired role mapping CSV or mapping table
ben_ae: Also note: If they want session affinity for long lived chat sessions, consider enabling dedicated GPUs in Dedicated plan — affects latency/SLA.
amanda_sales: Perfect. Can someone turn this into a one-pager and the quick answers for the security questionnaire? ZenCloud needs that by EOD Friday.
liz_seclead: I'll create the security Q&A snippet: include supported ciphers, signing algos, audit logging retention (90 days by default), SOC2 statement link, and our contact for pen-test scheduling.
deploybot: deploy status: no related deploys in last 24h.
ben_ae: I'll draft the one-pager + price ballpark and upload to the share link by EOD.
amanda_sales: Thanks team — I'll loop in ZenCloud and get them to confirm encrypted assertion requirement. :thumbsup:
